notes.title: Winter Sale in Full Swing! 🎉 Thank You for Sharing!
notes.notes:
This winter sale has been going well, especially overseas, with support from the US, Europe, and China. I sincerely thank you all for your continued support.

As a small indie developer, I don’t have any effective ways to promote my work internationally. In Japan, Twitter (or X) is the dominant platform, but I understand that’s not the case in many of your countries. Despite this, seeing sales and wishlists grow makes me think that somewhere out there, someone has been spreading the word on my behalf. Thank you so much!

I want to let you know that I welcome the sharing of videos and screenshots of my work on social media. Here are some general guidelines:

[list]
[*] Please keep it within the boundaries of fair use.
[*] Apply filters to violent content.
[*] Add spoiler warnings when necessary.
[/list]
What exactly constitutes "fair use"? It's a tricky question, and ultimately, it depends on the goodwill and judgment of the community. Based on the reviews and bug reports I’ve seen, the players of my games seem to be among the most considerate and thoughtful. So, please feel free to share as you like—I'm sure it will be just fine!

Your reviews, shares, short comments, likes, and even a simple wishlist click keep me going as a developer. I want to express my heartfelt gratitude once again and wish that the coming year brings a little more peace and happiness to all of you. From Japan, I’ll be keeping you in my thoughts.

notes.title: 🎄 "Lost in the Spring - Art Book" is Now Available as DLC! 🎄
notes.notes:
"Lost in the Spring - Art Book", the official digital art book for Haru to Shura, is now available as a downloadable DLC. 📖

This 30-page digital art book features pixel art backgrounds, story stills, character designs, and some behind-the-scenes commentary. It’s a small glimpse into the creative process behind Haru to Shura, and I hope you enjoy revisiting the game’s world through this collection.

As a solo developer, I wasn’t able to fully test the DLC on all systems. If you encounter any issues with downloading or accessing the PDF, please don’t hesitate to let me know. I really appreciate your patience and understanding.

Thank you so much for supporting my work this year. I’m currently working on new projects and hope to share them with you in the future. Wishing you a wonderful holiday season and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Haru to Shura Unofficial Super Duper Fast Mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38184176/22e9da5b4de5ac2a5105f6cdf467dc3de2a9c01a.jpg[/img]

1. Open the file option.ini in the folder where game.exe is located.
(double click it to open it in a text editor)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38184176/1eab195e96237953de5cad7c2231f8f41e1078a1.png[/img]

2. change speedmode = 1.0 to speedmode = 3.0, save and close the file

3. launch the game and [b]Use F3 key[/b] to switch speed.　

Not only text, but every movement will be faster. It will be harder to get into doors and any emotion will be lost. This is an unofficial feature, so please use it at your own risk.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, as it was developed with tools suitable for action games.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: ［Apology] The save data of the trial version will be lost.
notes.notes:
Due to the change of save format from auto to manual, the save data of the demo version will be lost with the latest update!
With the change, there are now three save slots and you can choose where to save.
This is the result of major improvements, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38184176/4518be3b2abe83239a9a137739f7819dcd8c4a97.jpg[/img]

In addition, the demo version has been updated as follows
-Added support for high refresh rate environments.
-Increased the number of hints in the game (you can sit on the couch)
-Adjusted screen size
-Added and fixed some dialogues and CG
-Sometimes you can eat at the bar

Then we'll have a release date announcement soon.
Follow us on Twitter, stay tuned, and stay healthy.

notes.title: Announcement: Haru to Shura demo version released and full release postponed
notes.notes:
- The demo version of Haru to Shura has now been released, which takes around 20-30 minutes to complete. You can download the demo version on the store page.
* The save data from the demo version cannot be transferred to the full version.

- Haru to Shura was planned for release in November 2020, but will have to be postponed for the time being to raise funds. We will let you know when the full game is planned to be released here or on our official Twitter, @miyakoshuppan.
